verdict.rationale: Orb documents a real-time webhooks system that calls an endpoint of your choosing when certain events occur. The pack does not show which subscription lifecycle events are covered, and nothing documents delivery reliability. Plan changes, edits and dunning retries are documented, but none of them is tied to a webhook emission. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of webhook events for renewal, upgrade, payment failure and cancellation; webhook delivery guarantees (retries, signatures, ordering, replay); independent or hands-on corroboration.
